# Error Handling Requirements Checklist: SPEC-009C3 - Dev/Review/Aegis to Ready for Owner

**Purpose**: Validate SPEC-009C3 error-handling and fail-closed requirements before task generation
**Created**: 2026-05-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are review `fix` requirements defined to record durable verdict evidence and block Aegis advancement, owner-review advancement, and `ready_for_owner`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, §FR-006, Contract §Review Fix Path]
- [x] CHK002 Are Aegis `rejected` requirements defined to retain rejection evidence and prevent owner-ready state while preserving bounded retry behavior? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Contract §Aegis Rejected Path]
- [x] CHK003 Does the spec define fail-closed behavior when a required SPEC-009C3 stage artifact cannot be published or superseded, including a durable failure record and no owner-ready side effects? - [x] CHK004 Are governance resource-policy, budget, window, and `readiness_blocked=true` violations specified as readiness-blocking errors? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, Contract §Governance Evidence]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Are allowed review and Aegis decision vocabularies closed enough that unsupported values fail closed rather than falling through to static routing? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010b, Contract §C3 Review Transition Guard]

[Resolved, Spec §FR-020, Spec §SC-011, Plan §State-Management Decision, Contract §Readiness Failure Semantics]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK009 Are missing evidence, wrong workspace, unsupported verdict/status, missing Aegis approval, and missing PR linkage all defined as fail-closed readiness scenarios? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-010b, Data Model §Fail-Closed Conditions]
- [x] CHK010 Are retry scenarios defined so corrected work may proceed without deleting prior failure evidence or duplicating stale successors? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-009, Data Model §State Transitions]
- [x] CHK011 Are automated fixture validation scenarios separated from live operator UAT so automated tests cannot mutate real GitHub PRs? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013, Spec §FR-014, Quickstart §Fixture Validation Path]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK012 Do success criteria require 100% fail-closed outcomes for review `fix`, Aegis `rejected`, missing Aegis approval, and zero automated live GitHub PR mutation? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-002, §SC-003, §SC-004, §SC-006]
- [x] CHK013 Is there a measurable success criterion proving artifact publish/supersede failures and blocked readiness attempts leave the dev task non-owner-ready with no owner-ready side effects? [Resolved, Spec §SC-010, Spec §SC-011]

## Notes

- CHK003 was resolved by adding FR-010d, SC-010, artifact publish/supersede failure semantics in the contract/data model, and blocked-path quickstart expectations.
- CHK006 was resolved by adding FR-020, SC-011, plan state-management wording, and a contract Readiness Failure Semantics section that enumerates forbidden owner-ready side effects.
- CHK008 was resolved by adding FR-014a plus contract/quickstart live-smoke fail-closed conditions for missing/non-draft/wrong-task PR identity, unexpected mutation, merge/done reconciliation, and missing cleanup evidence.
- CHK013 was resolved by adding measurable SC-010 and SC-011 outcomes.
